course_subtitle: Welcome, future champion in the world of mobile application manufacturing! Here you will create real Android applications that speak with your voice, calculate numbers, and draw with colors. Open the terminals and create your first app!

stations.title: Station 1: Text-to-Speech app
stations.desc: Learn how to program the mobile button to convert written text into audible speech (Text-to-Speech) with a beautiful accent.
stations.story: Welcome, little app developer! The mobile phone is very smart and can read any text out loud. We use the Text-to-Speech tool and program the button to say the welcome phrase when pressed.
stations.simple: Like the voice assistant Siri or Google! You write words to him and he speaks them in his distinctive robotic voice in order to help people who cannot read!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("Welcome to the Megaminds Mobile App") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence Welcome to the Megaminds mobile app to simulate mobile pronunciation.
stations.starter_code: # Simulate mobile pronunciation of written speech:

pills.label: Turn on the pronunciation app
pills.code: print("Welcome to the Megaminds mobile application")

validation_rules.required_output_text: Welcome to the Megaminds mobile application

stations.title: Station 2: Calculator and animal sounds
stations.desc: Program a smart calculator application that adds numbers and emits a beautiful cat sound (meow) when the result appears!
stations.story: Apps make counting fun! We program two fields to enter numbers, and when the (add) button is pressed, the application calculates the result and plays a cartoon sound file to encourage the user.
stations.simple: Like a calculator on a mobile phone, but it's better! Every time the result comes out, you get the sound of a celebration or the sound of a pet that makes you happy!
stations.hint: Type calc = 50 + 50 then print("Score 100 with meow sound playing!").
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase Score 100 with the meow sound playing! to simulate a calculator.

validation_rules.required_output_text: Score 100 with the meow sound playing!

stations.title: Stop 3: Canvas
stations.desc: Use Canvas to program an application that allows the user to draw with his finger on the mobile screen in color!
stations.story: The mobile screen turns into a magic drawing board! We use the Canvas element and program an event (when the finger is dragged) to draw colored lines and change the size of the pen easily.
stations.simple: Like a tablet and a digital sketchbook! You walk your finger across the screen, choose red or blue, and create the most beautiful drawings!
stations.hint: Type print("Paint and Finger Paint was launched successfully").
stations.challenge: Print Paint and Finger Drawing Application Launched Successfully to emulate the Paint application.
stations.starter_code: # Simulating the paint application on mobile:

pills.label: Run the Paint application
pills.code: print("The Paint and Finger Drawing application was launched successfully")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The Paint and Finger Drawing application ran successfully

stations.title: Station 4: IQ application
stations.desc: Create a smart competition application that displays questions and calculates points in the Score variable when the correct answer is chosen.
stations.story: Competition applications activate the mind! We program a screen that displays a question and buttons for choices. If the user clicks on the correct answer, a congratulatory message appears and the point counter increases.
stations.simple: Like Who Wants to be a Millionaire! You will be given the question and 4 choices, and if you answer correctly, your balance will increase and you will move to the next question!
stations.hint: Type print("Correct answer! 10 points added to your score").
stations.challenge: Print the congratulatory message Correct answer! 10 points have been added to your balance to simulate the competition application.

pills.label: IQ quiz answer
pills.code: print("Correct answer! 10 points have been added to your balance")

validation_rules.required_output_text: Correct answer! 10 points have been added to your balance

stations.title: Station 5: Balloon popping application
stations.desc: Program a fun game to pop moving balloons on the mobile screen when you touch them with your finger!
stations.story: Action games on mobile are so much fun! We program cartoon objects in the form of balloons that move randomly, and when touched (TouchDown), they explode and make a beautiful popping sound.
stations.simple: Like famous mobile games! You prefer to quickly press your finger on the flying balloons in order to pop them all and win the challenge!
stations.hint: Type print("The balloon was popped successfully and the point was calculated").
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence The balloon was popped successfully and the point was calculated to simulate the game.

pills.label: Pop the balloon
pills.code: print("The balloon was popped successfully and the point was calculated")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The balloon was successfully popped and the point was calculated

stations.title: Station 6: Vibrating stone paper scissors application
stations.desc: The grand final stop! Use the Accelerometer to play rock-paper-scissors when shaking your phone!
stations.story: The big final stop on mobile applications! We use the vibration sensor in the mobile phone (Accelerometer). When the player shakes the mobile phone vigorously, the application randomly chooses rock, paper, or scissors and announces the winner!
stations.simple: Magic game costume! You shake the mobile phone in your hand, and as soon as you stop, the screen shows you an image of a stone or a piece of paper, and you play with your friends!
stations.hint: Type print(“The mobile phone was shaken and the rock-paper-scissors game was successfully played!”).
stations.challenge: Print the closing phrase The mobile phone has been shaken and the rock-paper-scissors game has been successfully played! to celebrate your graduation as a professional application developer!
stations.starter_code: # Vibration sensor simulation and closing game:

pills.label: Shake the mobile and play
pills.code: print("The mobile phone was shaken and the rock-paper-scissors game played successfully!")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The mobile phone was shaken and the rock-paper-scissors game played successfully!
